author: OwnPBX
description: Reseller accounts: each reseller is a tenant with their own sub-portal, their own extensions, their own trunk and their own billing. v1 is the foundation — reseller records, host-to-tenant resolution, and tenant scoping on the Users and Extensions lists. Trunk routing, dialplan islands, DID purchases, Stripe payments and white-label domains come later.

Trunk routing, dialplan islands, DID purchases, Stripe payments and white-label domains come later.

name: Reseller Accounts

settings_schema.help: Base domains the admin offers for stock addresses, one per line. A reseller picks one when created; resellers without a custom domain log in at <subdomain>.<base>. Empty = the portal's own domain. The old single-domain setting is still honoured when set.
settings_schema.label: Stock base domains (one per line)
